'''Uogo'cor''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]], just off the [[Trax Tube/Legends|Trax Tube]]. Its port often serviced the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that preyed on the Trax Tube.<ref name="SWAJ2">{{JournalCite|2|Rebel Privateers!}}</ref> The name translated from the [[Language/Legends|language]] of the native [[Uogo]] meant "home of the suffering ones".

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.

A settlement was established on Uogo'cor by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Gangster/Legends|gang]], [[Dark Warbirds]]. The gang held control of the [[Star system/Legends|system]] for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]], subjugating the native population until the [[Uogo'cor suppression|arrival]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

The [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Sumok]] [[Death/Legends|died]] in a battle over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], fighting against an Imperial [[Guardian-class light cruiser|Customs cruiser]].<ref name="TBSB">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>

The world was overrun by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] shortly after they arrived in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="Atlas" />
